desc:
☕ Turn your tiny cafe into a coffee empire!

Brew delicious drinks, collect rare beans, and grow your business one cup at a time!

🫘 Discover collectible beans, powerful bonuses, and special mutations!
👩‍🍳 Hire baristas, upgrade your equipment, and unlock new recipes!
🏪 Expand your franchise and earn offline income while you're away!
⚔️ Team up with friends and raid rival cafes!
✨ Decorate your cafe and show off your favorite finds!
🤝 Trade with other players and join a Coffee Company to tackle challenges together!
⭐ Rebirth for permanent upgrades and make your next cafe even stronger!

How big can your coffee empire grow?!
